name: Lost Fleet
summary: The Lost Fleet lies broken off the Wetlands’ northern coast, along Baradin Bay. The Kul Tiras Third Fleet was destroyed in the Second War by red dragons enslaved by the Dragonmaw clan, and its wrecks are haunted by cursed undead sailors.

sections.title: A Tragic End in the Second War
sections.body: On its last voyage in the Second War, the Kul Tiras Third Fleet came under attack from red dragons enslaved by the Dragonmaw clan. Dragonflame engulfed its ships, and the Wave Mistress and the Intrepid crashed onto the shallows and reefs of northern Bluegill Marsh. Almost the entire contingent drowned or burned. First Mate Fitzsimmons was the lone living survivor.

sections.title: The Curse of Paleth
sections.body: The sailors of the Third Fleet did not find rest in their watery grave. Deep in the Intrepid’s sunken cargo hold lay the Cursed Eye of Paleth, a forbidden artifact hoarded by the ship’s greedy commander, Captain Halyndor. The relic corrupted the drowned crews and bound their spirits to the broken timbers as raving, cursed undead. Only the ghost of First Mate Snellig retains any semblance of sanity. He wanders the marshy shore while his former crewmates lash out violently at anyone who comes near the wrecks.

faq.answer: The Lost Fleet is the wreckage of several Kul Tiras warships from the Third Fleet, lying off the Wetlands’ northern coast in Baradin Bay. Destroyed in the Second War, the ships are haunted by their undead crews.
During the Second War, red dragons enslaved by the orcish Dragonmaw clan ambushed and burned the fleet. Dragonflame reduced the ships to burning hulks that foundered along the coast.

faq.q: Why are the sailors here undead?
faq.answer: A curse binds the sailors’ spirits to the wrecks. First Mate Fitzsimmons seeks help to learn why they cannot rest.

faq.q: Did anyone survive the destruction of the fleet?
faq.answer: First Mate Fitzsimmons of the Wave Mistress is the only known living survivor of the disaster. He reached safety and now lives at Menethil Harbor.

angles.text: The hulks remind the Alliance of the heavy toll Kul Tiras and the Alliance paid in the Second War. The fallen deserve respect, and their cursed torment must end.
Alliance smiths hear tales of the sunken fleet. Another ship from the same squadron, the Flying Osprey, went down carrying rare ingots of Lightforge iron.
